profiles.scope: Unchanged proposed powers, parameters and sensitivity endpoints; not calibrated Mars hardware

scenario.scope: Preserve approved 120 s visual check-in and 20 percent reserve policy as the controlled baseline; new allocations are unapproved

samples.scope: Approximately 10 min documented sample in a terrestrial D-RATS analog; the 420/180 light/heavy split is our engineering assumption

power.scope: 110 W beginning-of-mission MMRTG reference only, no generation credit or battery capacity assumption

sol.scope: Mean Mars solar day: 24 hours 39 minutes 35.244 seconds; calendar reference only, not a daylight or thermal model

flight12.scope: 169.5 s historical Flight 12 comparison supplied for context; not a certified flight-time bound

reserve_basis.derivation: Nominal requirement divided by 1-r; unused reserve is not consumed work

rounding_basis.justification: Readable requested allocations rounded upward; never comparison-tolerance budget credit

human_basis.interpretation: Check-in retains approved meaning; complete workflow includes documentation once; no optional inspection capability or work evidence is created

rover_basis.interpretation: Visual/geometric inspection block, not measured spectroscopy, drilling or chemical analysis; coordinate wait is a proposed schedule allowance

drone_basis.interpretation: Vertical segments and hover surrogates are disjoint costing assumptions, not aerodynamic takeoff/landing or obstacle clearance validation

joint_adverse.profile_endpoints: Minimum speeds and efficiencies; maximum masses, grade slowdown, slip, rolling resistance, auxiliary/activity powers and oxygen multiplier where registered

joint_adverse_basis.interpretation: Combined stress case, not a probability, confidence interval or proof of global worst case; failed resource margins are retained

calendar_basis.interpretation: One/two-sol standby thought experiment; full sleep, thermal, communications, recharge and state-of-charge model unavailable

case_field_basis.interpretation: Distances include the full modeled return, positive ascent occurs once with directed descent on return. Named sectors motivate workload diversity but these are not measured routes, actual target coordinates or assigned tasks.

limitations: Distances/ascent/stations are proposed workloads, not extracted terrain routes or completed work.
Conditional upon georegistration, public geometry/uncertainty, instruments, model agreement and separate approvals.
Joint adverse endpoints are a declared stress case, not confidence bounds or a global worst-case proof.
Human oxygen is metabolic dry-gas equivalent, excluding complete life-support losses; Wh is metabolic, not suit battery energy.
No wind cleaning, charging, generation, sleep or thermal capacity is assumed; gross energy is not stored battery availability.
Aircraft phases are surrogates; neither clearance nor aerodynamic/flight validation is established.
Campaign beyond the priced episode needs explicit gap costs; no idle interval is free and no sortie resets cumulative energy.
